tasks.short: Evaluate component environmental compliance and write the supported determination.

steps.what: Retrieve component specifications, supplier declarations and applicable environmental standards
Determine the applicable environmental requirements and component variants under assessment
Record the selected components' evidence against each applicable requirement
Assess whether the components comply and resolve unsupported or conflicting evidence
Write the component compliance determination and its supporting evidence references

tasks.design: Configure a component evidence collection in {DOCS} and a requirement matrix in {SPREADSHEET}. Native headings reduce retrieval and record preparation; the technician determines applicability, evaluates the evidence and separately writes the compliance assessment.
tasks.previous_blocker: Component declarations and evidence are repeatedly found and organised for assessment.
tasks.enabler_now: Native reference views and matrix templates can support a traceable assessment.
tasks.still_hard: Supplier declarations may cover different variants, conditions or requirement versions.
tasks.human_edge: Decide whether evidence actually supports compliance for the selected use.

ambition.what: Find missing component declarations earlier in selection.

tasks.altitude: Focus on evidence applicability rather than repeated matrix setup.

reach.learn: Distinguish a declaration's scope from an unqualified compliance claim.

evidence.claim: Native evidence views and requirement matrix templates could reduce supporting component assessment work; no automated compliance verdict is established.

assumptions: The technician produces component variant, intended use, requirement edition, declaration reference, evidence scope and gap fields in s3, retaining 15 hours. Missing or mismatched declarations require manual resolution rather than inferred compliance.
The written assessment is part of this task and separately priced. No certification, external filing or new approval procedure is introduced.
Native views and templates precede custom rules or models. Ordinary internal author saves retain their incidental time and have no approval stage or separate saving.
unknowns: Component variant metadata and coverage of supplier declarations.
research_questions: Does a native evidence matrix reduce preparation when declarations cover multiple component variants?

already_counted.description: Capture evidence scope and requirement references in the matrix.

incremental.description: Maintain evidence headings and requirement references.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central E1 case: B=100, R=88, gross=12; upkeep=3 gives net=9. Conservative case: variant ambiguity leaves retrieval at 20 hours, matrix writing at 18 and assessment writing at 13; with scope and judgement retaining 45 hours, R=96 and net=1. Consistent declaration metadata gives retrieval 18, matrix 17 and writing 12, R=92 and net=5.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop a written environmental impact programme and implement its agreed engineering activities.

steps.what: Discuss engineering activities, environmental impacts and implementation constraints with colleagues
Retrieve environmental requirements, engineering records and relevant previous programmes
Choose feasible programme measures, responsibilities and implementation sequence
Write the environmental programme brief and its implementation particulars
Develop the written environmental impact programme from the selected measures

loop.purpose: Draft the programme text expressing the technician's selected measures.
loop.input: Written brief, responsibilities, sequence and identified reference passages.
loop.output: Programme draft with source references and visible gaps.
loop.check: Technician verifies each measure, responsibility, impact statement and sequence against the brief and references.
loop.stop: One revision; unsupported claims or unsuitable instructions are written manually.
loop.why_not_simpler: A template supplies headings but cannot explain varied engineering activities and chosen measures.

steps.what: Send the checked final programme and implementation responsibilities to participating colleagues
Implement the assigned environmental measures within the engineering activities
Record completed programme activities, observed effects and remaining implementation issues

tasks.design: Use native programme references and headings in {DOCS}, then bounded drafting from an explicit programme brief. Keep measure selection and implementation with the technician, separately send the final programme through {EMAIL}, and record completed activities afterward in {PROJECT}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Engineering discussions and chosen measures must be turned into a usable written programme.
tasks.enabler_now: An explicit brief and selected references can constrain programme drafting.
tasks.still_hard: Measures must fit actual engineering constraints and produce meaningful environmental effects.
tasks.human_edge: Choose feasible measures and adapt implementation to actual conditions.

ambition.what: Review implementation gaps while keeping programme measures traceable.

tasks.altitude: Spend programme work on feasible measures and observed effects rather than repeated prose.

reach.learn: Distinguish planned measures from completed activities and measured effects.

evidence.claim: Native programme templates and source-bounded drafting could reduce written programme preparation; the task-specific saving is E1.

assumptions: This scenario includes development and implementation of a written programme. Discussion, selection, brief capture, programme writing, communication, implementation and completion records are separate phases.

The technician produces objectives, selected measures, responsibilities, sequence, constraints and source references in s4 with all five hours retained. Unsupported impact estimates remain unknown and require manual investigation.
The loop cannot choose environmental measures, invent legal obligations or claim measured effects. Native headings and prior programme material are tried first.
The actual internal send checks final programme and recipients within its five retained hours. Ordinary internal author saves have no approval stage or separate saving.
unknowns: Existing programme format and how environmental effects are evidenced.
research_questions: Does programme drafting reduce total writing after checking feasibility, responsibilities and unsupported impact claims?

already_counted.description: Check and correct the programme draft against the written brief.

incremental.description: Maintain reference material and programme drafting checks.

approvals.approved_version: Exact final programme, responsibilities, sequence and colleague recipients; edits or recipient changes require a fresh send-time check.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central E1 case: B=100, R=87, gross=13; upkeep=3 gives net=10. Conservative case: novel activities prevent reference and completion-entry savings, while programme correction retains 21 of 25 writing hours; R=96, net=1. A reusable outline with lookup at nine, programme writing at 18 and completion record at four saves nine hours, R=91, net=6. Discussion, selection, brief capture, send and implementation retain 60 hours.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare and deliver robot training, then assess and record the trainee's completion.

steps.what: Retrieve current robot installation, use and maintenance instructions
Assess trainee experience and the robot tasks they need to perform
Write the robot training plan and select practical exercises
Record trainee enrolment, session arrangements and required equipment
Send the final robot training notice and preparation instructions to trainees
Train colleagues to install, use or maintain robots through supervised practice
Assess trainee performance and identify further robot training needs
Record training completion, assessment outcome and required follow-up

tasks.design: Configure robot instruction views and practical training headings in {DOCS}, with completion fields in {LMS}. Keep enrolment and the real notice through {EMAIL} before training, retain demonstration and assessment, and record completion afterward.
tasks.previous_blocker: Instructions and exercise headings are repeatedly assembled before hands-on training.
tasks.enabler_now: Native reference collections, training headings and completion fields can support preparation and records.
tasks.still_hard: Safe practice and competence depend on observing the trainee with the actual robot.
tasks.human_edge: Adapt teaching and intervene when a trainee's actions are unsafe or misunderstood.
tasks.altitude: Spend robot training effort on supervised practice rather than repeated preparation.

reach.learn: Recognise the limits of demonstrated competence and when to seek help.

evidence.claim: Native robot instruction collections, training headings and completion fields could reduce preparation and recording without replacing practical teaching.

assumptions: This scenario includes existing training plans, enrolment and completion records. Those writes and the real notice are separated from teaching, with enrolment before and completion after the session.

The technician selects references in s1 and writes exercises and safety scope in s3, retaining 12 hours. Trainee identity, session and equipment are captured in s4 with five retained hours; completion and follow-up are captured in s8 with four retained hours. Missing details require manual clarification.
Native headings and fields come first; no model teaches robot safety or decides competence. Trainees are colleagues, so communication has internal authority.
The actual notice has a final-content and recipient check. Ordinary author saves need no additional approval or save-only saving.
unknowns: Robot variants and existing reusable exercises.
research_questions: How much preparation remains when a robot variant requires new practical exercises?

already_counted.description: Write the robot-specific training plan and exercises.

incremental.description: Maintain current robot references and exercise headings.

approvals.approved_version: Exact final training notice, session, equipment requirements, preparation instructions and trainee recipients; changes require a fresh send-time check.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central E1 case: B=100, R=94, gross=6; upkeep=2 gives net=4. Conservative case: a new robot variant needs full reference lookup, plan writing retains 14 of 15 hours and completion four of five; R=98, net=0. Compatible exercises with lookup nine, plan 13 and completion four give R=96, net=2. Needs assessment, enrolment, notice, practice and competency assessment retain 70 hours.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Analyse electromechanical designs against actual implementation requirements and record the findings.

steps.what: Retrieve engineering designs, component specifications and current system documentation
Examine the existing system and clarify implementation constraints with engineers
Record system interfaces, operating constraints and design implementation requirements
Analyze circuitry, controls, instrumentation or acquisition designs for system implementation
Write the design analysis findings and recommended implementation changes
Send the checked design analysis to the responsible engineer

tasks.design: Configure linked drawing and specification views in {OTHER}, the engineering design viewer, and findings headings in {DOCS}. Retain system examination, requirement capture and design analysis; separately write and send the findings through {EMAIL}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Relevant design references and repeated findings headings slow implementation analysis.
tasks.enabler_now: Native design views and document templates can support lookup and record writing.
tasks.still_hard: Compatibility depends on actual interfaces, operating conditions and failure behaviour.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise implementation risks that a drawing or component specification alone does not settle.
tasks.altitude: Improve the traceability of design analysis while retaining engineering judgement.

reach.learn: Connect each proposed change to an observed constraint or design finding.

evidence.claim: Eplan Copilot answers from verified documentation; this supports reference assistance, not autonomous analysis of control-system implementation.
Native design views and findings templates could shorten lookup and writing; the estimated saving is an E1 scenario.

assumptions: OTHER means the engineering design viewer. No automated design verdict, simulation run, controller change or equipment actuation is proposed.

The technician produces interface identity, operating limits, observed constraints and source drawing revisions in s3, retaining all 15 hours. Missing or incompatible references require manual clarification.
Findings writing is separate from examining the system and analysing the designs. The colleague send is separately priced and checks its exact final version and recipient.
Try native views and findings headings first. Ordinary same-system author saves have no approval stage or separate saving.
unknowns: Compatibility of drawing layers, reference links and revision metadata.
research_questions: Do native views reduce lookup when legacy drawings lack compatible layers or current revision metadata?

already_counted.description: Write the engineering analysis with source-linked findings.

incremental.description: Maintain design reference links and findings headings.

approvals.approved_version: Exact written design analysis, referenced drawing revisions and responsible engineer recipient; changes require a fresh send-time check.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central E1 case: B=100, R=93.25, gross=6.75; upkeep=2 gives net=4.75. Conservative case: incompatible drawing layers leave lookup at 15 hours, while findings headings retain 13 of 15 writing hours; R=98, net=0. Compatible revision links give lookup 13 and findings writing 12, R=95, net=3. System examination, requirements, analysis and send retain 70 hours.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Retain engineering and training judgement while improving the supporting programme, assessment and record work.
reach: Connect component evidence and system constraints with clear programmes, training and design findings.
skills_to_grow: Separate practical assessment from record preparation
role.ambitious_version: A mechatronics technician who produces traceable assessments and programmes while personally judging system compatibility and trainee competence.

job.title: Electro-Mechanical and Mechatronics Technologists and Technicians
